sloka: तासां मध्यगतो राजा रराज च तदार्जुनः ।करेणूनां सहस्रस्य मध्यस्थ इव कुञ्जरः ।। ७.३२.३ ॥
transliteration: tāsāṁ madhyagato rājā rarāja ca tadārjunaḥ ।kareṇūnāṁ sahasrasya madhyastha iva kuñjaraḥ ।। 7.32.3 ॥

translations.english: King Kartavirya Arjuna, situated amidst those women, shone splendidly, just like a male elephant standing in the midst of a thousand female elephants.
